name: A Package for Space
summary: A real race against time, your priorities will be the key to success..

name: The Phoenix Gene
summary:
The Phoenix Gene is an adrenaline-fueled VR quest for immortality.
Control a fierce phoenix, Firestorm, and genetically enhanced Jackie, bonded by fate and driven by the collapse of the Slipstream multiverse.
Total Immersion. Total Action: Fly, dodge, and move your body in this adventurous ‘schumupp.

name: Palia: The Elderwood
summary: Welcome to the Elderwood! Step into an ancient overgrown forest teeming with magic in the Elderwood Expansion — Palia’s biggest update to date! Explore the new Adventure Zone and discover powerful artifacts and relics, complete exciting new quests, meet mischievous (but cute!) critters, find loads of new collectibles, decor, and so much more!

name: Grounded 2
summary: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

name: Age of Mythology: Retold - Heavenly Spear
summary: Unleash 12 new gods in a mythic Japanese campaign and multiplayer. Command powerful samurai, shadowy ninjas and creatures from Japanese mythology in this epic expansion.

name: Periapsis: Eclipse
summary: Conquer the Settled Galaxy in Periapsis: Eclipse, a unique roguelite where gravity, heat and the physics of space are the keys to conquest. Master orbital mechanics, real-world inspired weapons and nuclear rockets to outmaneuver dozens of hostile ships and claim victory for the Exiled Empire.

name: Keeper
summary: From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is an atmospheric puzzle adventure in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is a first-person shooter set in 2035, co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software. The game features three main modes: a cooperative campaign playable with up to four players or solo, multiplayer with 6v6 and 20v20 modes, and the round-based Zombies mode. Multiplayer features a perk system split into combat specialties, weapon prestige progression, and scorestreak rewards.

name: Ambrosia Sky
summary: You are Dalia, a deep-space disaster specialist dispatched to the rings of Saturn. You’ll lay victims to rest, clean up alien fungus, and research its strange origins. Adapt to survive, cleanse the contamination, and escape the crisis.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition
summary: The Fate of The Forgotten Realms is in Your Hands. Return to the city of Neverwinter in Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition.

name: Citizen Pain
summary: Citizen Pain is a first-person dark fantasy action game. Play as Catherina, warrior princess of the Moges Empire, who gains the supernatural force known as Pain and leads the fight against the Undead King. Classic single-player combat meets modern visuals in this skill-based indie experience.

name: Nirih
summary: Fly across worlds in pursuit of tainted souls that will corrupt the realms they inhabit. Boost your speed by following their trails and battling their creations, while dodging obstacles in your hunt.

name: Hogtie
summary: Dive into Hogtie, the ultimate Sokoban puzzle adventure where you wrangle mischievous pigs with your trusty lasso and guide them back to their pens! Explore different biomes, navigate tiles with unique effects, and enjoy character customization to make the gameplay experience truly yours.

name: Blippo+
summary: Blippo+ is a live-action, off-cable TV simulator. Channel-surf the stars and discover the staticky, radical world of Planet Blip through its soaps, sitcoms, news, weather, and talk shows. But don't touch that remote—everything's about to get bent.

name: Farmer’s Market Simulator
summary: Escape the corporate grind and embrace farm life in Farmer’s Market Simulator! Grow crops, raise animals, and run your own market. Manage resources, upgrade your farm, and sell fresh produce to build a thriving business. Can you turn your dream into reality?

name: Yanloveless Simulator
summary:
YanLoveLess Simulator is a fangame of Yandere Simulator, developed by @jxstleslie for Windows, Android, and iOS. The game features custom characters in a dramatic high school setting.

Ana Mijlović is a young girl who recently transferred to a prestigious high school. Although seemingly calm and reserved, Ana hides a difficult past and deep emotional wounds. Marked by a tragic event at her old school, she develops a troubled view of love and attachment. Behind her melancholic gaze lies a fierce desire to never lose those she loves again, even if it means resorting to extreme behavior.

In YanLoveLess Simulator, Ana isn't just a rival or an ally: she's a character whose evolution depends on the player's choices. Can she be saved from her obsession? Or will she be consumed by her uncontrollable feelings?

name: Saloonery
summary: Grab your trusty revolver and blast away outlaws in this fast-paced shooter. You'll need to use the wide arsenal of weapons, your razor-sharp reflexes, and an itchy trigger finger to bring order to the lawless western frontier. It's Saloonery time!

name: Gone Fishing
summary: GONE Fishing is a co-op multiplayer survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

name: Becoming a King
summary: Take control of your destiny in "Becoming a King", an exciting time management romance game!

name: Double It
summary: Join the multiplayer online experience by spinning the fortune wheel in this deadly arena. Take your seat at a table with up to 6 players and earn money with every spin. Remember, deception can double your cash or be your downfall! Are you ready for an unforgettable night?

name: Light Up the Town
summary: Light Up The Town is a cozy, casual holiday game for all ages. Play as Bean, a precocious young ferret, and explore the town of Bellflower, Colorado as you hang up festive string lights around to spread holiday cheer. Click to throw a light or decoration; the only limit is your imagination.

name: Carefully Stamped
summary: Craft and sell charming postcards to your customers in a relaxing sandbox full of color and creativity. Carefully Stamped is a cozy job simulator where you are a postcard designer. Take on new orders, craft the cutest mail, write a wholesome note and collect stamps to send your postcards ️

name: Adventure of Samsara
summary: A hero resurrected. A new Adventure. With stunning, 2D pixel art, Adventure of Samsara combines classic gameplay, a deeply connected world, and a heady, twisting narrative of death, rebirth and memory. Become the Solar Champion and restore balance to the multiverse.

name: Dogwalk
summary: Play as a big adorable dog and explore a hand-crafted winter forest with a little kid in tow. A short, free, open source project brought to you by Blender Studio.

name: Beebo & Luna
summary: Start a healing journey with Beebo and Luna on your desktop! When you are with Beebo and Luna, the melody of time turns into the light of stars. Change outfits for Beebo and Luna, decorate the warm Dream Oracle House, meet mysterious travelers and start an incredible adventure.

name: Night Shift at the Museum
summary: Watch the cameras. Catch the anomalies. Report every irregularity. Repair the malfunctioning systems. While trying to meet your hourly reporting quota, various incidents may force you to move around the museum. When your reflection starts moving on its own, it's no longer just another night shift.

name: Roofgrown Life
summary: Roofgrown Life is a cozy idle farming game. You can collect fruits in various regions, plant and harvest them, complete customer orders, upgrade your vehicles and house, and explore to unlock new points of interest on the map.

name: Gutfarm
summary: Gutfarm is a top-down 2D pixel art game that blends farming, tower defense, and survival elements. On this alien island, you will expand and grow your farm by planting crops, unlocking genetically mutated varieties, defending against waves of monster attacks, collecting relics, and more!

name: Bloodface
summary: Unable to endure the ruthless tyranny of the Lord, the people rise in rebellion, plunging the entire country into civil war. As the Lord and his family abandon the throne and flee, a bloody battle erupts across the lands.

name: Desk Paws
summary: Collect over 100 stylish little pets on your desktop! They can freely move along the bottom of your screen, or live in the little houses you've carefully decorated for them. Hmm... or perhaps send them on adventures to earn treats?

name: Recyclic
summary: A deceptively demanding experience of a humble recycling plant worker. Shred, crush, and sort your way through a menial job while trying to keep track of the ever convoluted company policy. Clock in, recycle, get paid, repeat.

name: LabyrAInth
summary:
LABYRAINTH is a sci-fi fps game set in an alien world made of labyrinths. Avoid traps, shoot aliens, collect resources, upgrade weapons, activate powers, and most importantly escape the labyrinth, racing against time.

Race against time and other players in a roguelite, arcade-fps, maze-running game, a game unique in its genre. LABYRAINTH features many game modes to be played: follow the Story of the AI of LABYRAINTH an alien AI that captured in its world, of play online in a Infinite mode with infinite procedural labyrinths, or compete against other players in Ranked modes, or create you own custom labyrinths ready to play as you like and share them to the community or even play in a Survival mode with constant wave of aliens and compete against other players.

LABYRAINTH is mostly a single player game with a asynchronous multiplayer online game modes where other players will run on the same or similar labyrinths and score a time on live leaderboards.

name: Monkaru Fanta: Yuusha to Suishou no Shoujo
summary: Monkaru is an orthodox, retro-inspired turn-based fantasy RPG where you travel to defeat The Demon Lord with the help of a girl who was sealed in a crystal. The game is by Experience with character designs by Yuji Himukai and monster designs by Akifumi Yamamoto.

name: Delivery Pals
summary: Put on your thermos bags and head outside with your friends. You will have to deliver food to the aliens and make sure that the last company on Earth does not close down.

name: Ashen Reverie
summary: You've ignored the hallucinations for years. But after visiting a shrine in search of answers, a stranger claims she sees them too. Ashen Reverie is a supernatural thriller visual novel about the consequences of chasing a myth too far.

name: Lia: Hacking Destiny
summary: Be the resistance in a world ruled by machines: fight, hack, and reignite hope. Craft powerful builds in this fast-paced roguelite with lethal weapons and power-ups. Free kittens from the algorithm’s chains and smash the robots’ scheme. Resist spam and prove that no one codes your destiny!

name: A Flame in the Dark
summary: Navigate the darkest of dungeons equipped with only a torch. Explore, solve puzzles, and find a path forward to help the next adventurer before your only light source burns out in this unique roguelite!

name: Hellmaster: The Legend of Dante
summary: Hellmaster is a competitive, role-based strategy card game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy. Players descend into the underworld, choosing and evolving mythological heroes to build powerful decks and utilize tactical gameplay to outsmart their opponents. Prove your skills and claim epic rewards as you conquer Dante's nine circles of Hell, striving to become the ultimate Hellmaster.

name: Black Souls
summary: Black Souls is the censored release of a dark fantasy, souls-like RPG game inspired by Dark Souls and various fairy tales, where you are an unnamed undead who has awakened imprisoned within the Lost Empire. Freed by the brave Holy Knight Jeanne D'Arc, your freedom is short-lived as a fearsome dragon claims both your lives. Now you have one goal - to infiltrate the Lost Empire and defeat Cinderella, who spreads the fog that drains souls and drives everyone to insanity, but to get there, you will need to defeat or enter into a covenant with the Demonic Princesses.

name: RimWorld: Odyssey
summary: Explore exotic biomes, expand your mobile colony, and launch into space. Scavenge ancient tech on asteroids, abandoned space stations, and satellites. Find and defeat the mechanoid lair.

name: 100 Cats Lost in Italy
summary: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

name: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive
summary:
The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

name: Jason Maxx
summary: A man has fallen to his death in Metro City. Mysterious circumstances. Luckily, edgy 90’s detective Jason Maxx is on the case. The city is dark, the suspects are zany, and the graphics are Y2K-crusty. Explore, interrogate. Can Jason solve the mystery, even when absurdity takes over?

name: Ctesiphon
summary: A retrowave/mecha-inspired sci-fi first-person shooter featuring fast-paced combat in old-school style open-plan levels packed with pickups, keys, and secrets.

name: Still Wakes the Deep: Siren's Rest
summary: 1986. Over a decade has passed since the Beira D incident. A specialist dive team journeys to the North Sea to uncover the truth.

name: Peak
summary: Peak is a cooperative climbing game for up to four players. After crash-landing on an unknown island, players take the role of scouts attempting to ascend the mountain at its center. The mountain is semi-procedurally generated and changes every 24 hours, featuring five distinct biomes with unique obstacles and enemies. Players manage stamina, collect climbing tools like ropes and pitons, and must work together to survive hazards while ascending.

name: Liminal Border Part IV
summary: The conclusion of the Liminal Border visual novel series. After the countless twists and turns of Part III, Itsuki's business is now a massive success, but all he can see is the need for revenge. Standing on the border between justice and evil, which way will Itsuki fall?

name: World War Z VR
summary: Based on the hit game World War Z that has now captivated over 25 million players, World War Z VR is an immersive single-player first-person shooter experience with reimagined locations to explore. Take on huge swarms of zombies across three difficulty levels and choose your operator, weapons, and perks to create unique playthroughs.

name: Brainrot Kart
summary: Brainrot Kart is a 1-8 player kart racing game. Race with the homies through chaotic maps like "Gooning Gateway" and "The Backrooms," and launch Hawk Tuahs at your rivals to throw them off course. Expect nonstop brainrot that’ll keep you on edge.

name: Keep on Mining!
summary: Keep on Mining! is a short incremental mining game. Mine rocks, gather material, find artifact, craft pickaxes and spend your materials on permanent upgrades inside the big skill tree!

name: Honkai: Star Rail - For the Sun is Set to Die
summary:
Version 3.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Phainon, Saber, and Archer
• New Trailblaze Mission: "For the Sun is Set to Die"
• New areas: Aedes Elysiae
• New collaboration-themed event
• ...and more!

name: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek
summary: Enter the chilling world of Goosebumps in Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek! Unravel eerie mysteries, confront sinister monsters, and navigate haunted locations inspired by R.L. Stine’s legendary books —all while experiencing the Goosebumps signature blend of spooky adventure and playful twists

name: Chaos Zero Nightmare
summary: Chaos Zero Nightmare is a cosmic loop RPG. The official has announced that Chaos Zero Nightmare will come to us soon. Some glimpses of character animations were shown in the teaser, evoking a similar 2D art and animation style to Epic Seven.

name: Mesorift Survival
summary: Mesorift Survival is a classic survival game with PvP and PvE elements, set in a tropical open world with three islands. Gather resources, build a base, craft weapons, and survive deadly dinosaurs and rival players — solo or with friends.

name: Bleak Haven
summary: Bleak Haven is a cinematic survival horror where faith is twisted, every shot matters, and survival hangs on what you can build. Explore haunted ruins, abandoned villages, and face a cult preparing the world for a god no one should ever witness.

name: Golden Tee Arcade Classics
summary: Tee up the old-school fun with six classic Golden Tee arcade games, plus more!

name: Sector Force
summary: One pilot, thirty stranded workers, hundreds of asteroids heading their way.

name: Fever Meme
summary: Fever Meme is a comedy/parody game that pivots between multiple genres as it spits in the face of traditional game design. The game is self-aware of your actions as you play, your past mistakes, and so much more. And the further you make it into the game, the more the dynamic between player and creator is explored as the fourth wall is completely stripped away.

name: Still It Runs
summary: Still It Runs is a stealth adventure where you play as a cat, alone in a strangely silent house. Collect scattered memories, uncover what once happened here—and try to stay unseen.

name: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition
summary:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Enhanced Edition improves upon the original release by supporting 4K resolution at 60 FPS and enhancing visual effects, including RTX reflections, improved water effects, additional particles, and volumetric lighting.

It also offers players the option to choose between Quality Mode or Performance Mode, allowing them to prioritize either visual fidelity or frame rate based on their preferences.

name: The Sims 4: Enchanted by Nature
summary: Live surrounded by the magic of nature in The Sims 4 Enchanted by Nature Expansion Pack.

name: Hotel Infinity
summary:
At Hotel Infinity, every detail has been prepared for your arrival. Every corridor leads somewhere you’ve never been, and no room is ever quite the same. Explore at your leisure, but don’t wander too far. Designed entirely for roomscale VR, the hotel unfolds around you in impossible ways.

We hope your stay is eternal.

name: Drill Bird
summary: Drill Bird is a cozy-yet-tense digging platformer where every trip underground counts. Fallen from the sky, you search for powerful ores to hatch your egg. Bring them home, upgrade abilities, grow stronger, and unravel a story about survival, care, and purpose. Exploring, returning, and growing.

name: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Shadow of Kerensky
summary: Take on a 12-mission story campaign set during the Clan Invasion. Battle through a shifting Inner Sphere map, face powerful Clan OmniMechs, and salvage cutting-edge Clan tech.

name: Road to Empress I
summary: Step into the shoes of China's most legendary empress and experience her extraordinary life in this high-risk, full-motion video journey. Navigate desire, darkness, schemes, betrayal, and redemption with wisdom and courage. Seek rebirth and revenge, but face tough moral choices. How far will you go?

name: Paw Patrol: Rescue Wheels - Championship
summary: Va-room! The Rescue Wheels crew is revved up and ready to race! Join Chase, Skye, Marshall, Rubble, Zuma, Rocky, and Roxi, in epic races across Adventure Bay and beyond. You can even cause mischief with Boomer & Frank or Mayor Humdinger. Pick your Pup Racer, each with unique skills like launching tennis balls or spinning out rivals. Master drifting, turbo boosts, and epic signature stunts to rule the dirt roads. Play solo or challenge friends in multiplayer—every racer can be a champion! Grab your best Pup Pals and let’s Rox and roll!

name: Truck City
summary: Grow your truck fleet, build your city and design a supply chain to extract, refine and process natural resources into complex items. Manage your factories and optimize delivery logistics to prevent traffic jams. Unlock new research and turn your small mining town into an efficient industrial city.

name: Dear me, I was…
summary:
Dear me, I was… is an interactive adventure that lets you enjoy a story woven with beautiful visuals, fusing the vibrant watercolor style of Taisuke Kanasaki with rotoscoping technology.

In this story, you will relive the life of a certain woman. Experience joy, sorrow, and growth through her ordinary and humble life. Witness the story she weaves in a life interconnected with others.

name: Bubble Bobble: Sugar Dungeons
summary: Adventure again and again! Get stronger! The first step-up Bubble Bobble in the series! Go on an adventure through strange dungeons that change every time you step inside!

name: Kopi
summary: Welcome to KOPI, a family-friendly cooking game that can be enjoyed solo or with friends in co-op mode. In KOPI, you'll craft increasingly elaborate drinks and dishes for ever-demanding customers. Whether you're brewing, cooking, frying, cleaning, or serving, remember: it’s not over until the customer leaves happy.

name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 3
summary:
A special collaboration with FINAL FANTASY XIV Online, the hit MMORPG, is coming in Title Update 3!
Experience a fanciful story featuring characters who have wandered from the faraway realm of Eorzea—the world of FINAL FANTASY XIV Online.
Get ready for a surge of awesome collaboration content!

name: Valiants: Arena
summary: Strategic multiplayer monster battle game

name: A Little to the Left: Packed
summary: A Little to the Left wraps up with the free, final Packed Update.

name: Dread Flats
summary: This is a first-person Chinese horror game, players will go to a murder building, uncover the truth of the murder, find the missing people. Players will experience an intense sense of claustrophobia and horror, carefully designed scary points, a 1990s Chinese atmosphere, and mysterious, eerie, and twisted unknown entities.

name: Full Metal Schoolgirl
summary:
In the year 2089, the United Federation of Japan is an industrial powerhouse, while also being one of the world’s leading countries in overtime work.

In this sickening future, the economy is booming and working 24 hours a day is considered virtuous.

The core of this country’s industry, economy, and social system are controlled by a single giant corporation.

The rampage of a fully mechanized schoolgirl—a fully armed cyborg heroine storms into a giant corporation and unleashes a relentless barrage of gunfire and sword action in this exhilarating cyborg schoolgirl action adventure. The feeling of immorality is irresistible when you break into an office and wreak havoc.

name: Tekken 8: Fahkumram
summary:
Thunderous Roar Garuda
The undefeated Muay Thai champion is joining the fight!

While his wife and daughter are held hostage, Fahkumram remains under the control of the Thai military. With the belief that he will one day reclaim his sole purpose for living, Fahkumram has been sent to the battlefield in a military breaching vehicle.

name: SeaCret 1
summary: Sail into the 17th-century Caribbean in SeaCret 1, a riotous mix of strategy, humor, and adventure! Trade, fight, or govern your way to fame in this sandbox escapade, where every choice brings riches or ridiculousness.

name: Arcade Archives 2: Air Combat 22
summary:
"AIR COMBAT 22" is a flight shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1995. This title features an evolutionary step in 3D graphics and flashy animations using the "System Super 22" arcade board, an upgrade of the "System 22" architecture used for a wide range of legendary 3D games. Take on missions for the thrill of shooting down lots of enemy crafts, white-knuckle missions that require expert techniques, and more as you conquer diverse aerial combat scenarios. Become a hero of the skies!

The "Arcade Archives 2" series includes "ORIGINAL MODE", "HIGH SCORE MODE", "CARAVAN MODE", "TIME ATTACK MODE" and "NETWORK MODE". In "TIME ATTACK MODE"

name: In Arrears
summary: A survival horror game for anyone who's ever wept into an Excel sheet. Welcome to your new job! You’re underpaid, overworked, and haunted by rent. Literally. In In Arrears, time is money — and you’re chronically broke. The coffee's cold. HR is missing. And the tax men? Avoid them.

name: Wretch: Divine Ascent
summary: A dark fantasy 1v1 auto battler game with 3D action elements inspired by Backpack Battle You have a complete backpack that allows you to purchase various items (equipment, accessories, skills, etc.), creating a powerful build unique to you.

name: Resident Evil: Survival Unit
summary:
Dive in the world of "Resident Evil Survival Unit" for the ultimate survival experience, where strategy means everything!

In the world of “Resident Evil Survival Unit,” strategy holds the key to survival.
As an unknown infection spreads, the city crumbles in the blink of an eye.
You are left stranded in the ruins with a group of isolated survivors.
Build your base, secure resources, and expand your influence to carve out a path to survival!

name: The Smurfs: Flower Defense
summary:
Play the Smurfs as you’ve never played them before, in virtual and mixed reality!
The fairy Leaf is preparing to celebrate the magic of Nature along with the whole Smurf village. But little do they know that Gargamel will show up to spoil the party once again! Using a magic spell, he gets his hands on 20 Smurfs and chases the rest away from the village! Now more powerful than ever, Gargamel forces the Smurfs to flee, while the weakened Leaf returns to her flower state. After being dropped into their magical world, it is up to you to save the Smurfs, protect the Nature Fairy and stop Gargamel!

name: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite
summary: Lead a platoon of WWII tanks in this immersive TPP and FPP game. Engage in realistic, tactical combat across historic battlefields. Play through campaign or challenge yourself in skirmish mode as either German or US forces.

name: Is this a Game yet?
summary: Is this a Game yet? is a blank slate that players cooperatively design. Starting with just a button, you compete every week for 5 spots on a global leaderboard to have your idea implemented in the next update live on stream.

name: Baldi's Basics: Encounter Doors
summary: Baldi's Basics: Encounter Doors is a tense crossover game that blends the fear-inducing world of Baldi's Basics with the puzzle-filled challenge of Doors. Explore 100 procedurally generated rooms, each with unique puzzles and obstacles, while trying to avoid Baldi and his relentless friends. Solve the challenges, unlock new doors, and escape before they catch you!

name: Whispers from the Star
summary: An interactive story about connection in isolation… where your words are the lifeline of a stranded companion in space. In Whispers from the Star, there are no dialogue trees, just open-ended conversations powered by AI chat, as you stay connected across light years.

name: 5 Minutes Until Self-Destruction
summary: The self-destruction sequence has been activated. You have 5 minutes to solve your way out of a high-stakes, escape room-style disaster.

name: EA Sports FC 26
summary: EA Sports FC 26 is a football simulation game and the third entry in the EA Sports FC series, following the franchise's rebranding from FIFA. The game features various modes including career mode with narrative-driven Manager Live Challenges, and introduces Archetypes, a system that defines player playstyles based on real footballers. It is the successor to EA Sports FC 25.

name: Little Corners
summary: Peel, place, and arrange stickers across tiny windows into different worlds. Relax and unwind to lofi beats, collect unique stickers and share your cozy creations with the world.

name: NBA 2K26
summary: Bragging rights are on the line in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, The W, and Play Now. Showcase your bag of moves with hyper realism, Powered by ProPLAY, and challenge your friends, or rivals, in NBA 2K26’s competitive modes—and leave no doubt that you wear the crown.

name: Explorers Collection: The Oregon Trail & Carmen Sandiego Bundle
summary:
The Explorers Collection brings together two legendary educational games: The Oregon Trail and Carmen Sandiego, reimagining these iconic adventures for a new generation of players. This premium bundle offers an immersive journey through history, strategy, and global exploration.

• In The Oregon Trail, players navigate the challenging westward journey, making critical decisions that impact their party's survival. Facing obstacles like blizzards, broken limbs, and dysentery, players must strategically manage their resources and overcome numerous random events to reach Oregon before winter.

• Carmen Sandiego offers a thrilling global adventure where players team up with the world's greatest thief to track down the VILE syndicate. Using spy tools and exploring iconic global landmarks, players solve crimes while discovering geography, culture, and critical thinking through an engaging, story-driven gameplay experience.

name: My Wife Threw Out My Card Collection (So I Bought a Dump to Find Them All)
summary: One trash run — and it was all gone. Now it’s just you, a cart, and a thousand tons of garbage. But you’ll keep digging through every pile, searching for rare cards and nostalgic treasure. In this cozy trash-cleaning simulator.

name: Arcade Archives: Super Dimension Fortress Macross II
summary:
This is a time attack shoot 'em up!

The arcade game “Super Dimension Fortress MACROSS II” is a shooter released by BANPRESTO (Bandai Namco Entertainment inc.) in 1993.
The game follows the story of the original video animation “The Super Dimension Fortress Macross II -LOVERS AGAIN-”.
Set around 80 years after “The Super Dimension Fortress Macross,”
Earth is faced by a new threat that players must defeat - the Marduk.
Clear each stage by achieving the designated "CLEAR SCORE" within the time limit.

name: Majogami
summary: The sword fighter Shiroha cleaves through a twisted world with her high-speed Setsuna, facing off against the powerful witches in her way, in 2D paper craft character action. Paper craft character action! Majogami - the story of one girl who cuts gods like paper.

name: Xociety
summary:
XOCIETY is a third-person POP Shooter with an Extraction-based gameplay RPG core. Set in a deep Sci-Fi world. Starting with a core shooter experience XOCIETY will evolve into an engagement-first player experience. Featuring PvP and PvE gameplay combined with RPG mechanics.

Shoot, Earn, Pioneer: Now We Live in XOCIETY.
Welcome to XOCIETY.

XOCIETY aims to redefine gaming experiences with a strong emphasis on player engagement. It gives TPS players economic control, allowing them to take on the role of key economic agents within XOCIETY. In traditional TPS games, players' actions have little impact on the environment and market economy.

However, in XOCIETY, every decision you make creates diverse effects on gameplay, the environment, and the overall market economy.
Gain voting power, build wealth, and pioneer a new world.
That’s why we live in XOCIETY.

We invite you to join us on XOCIETY's Early Access journey. Participate now and experience the new world XOCIETY seeks to create. Your feedback will be invaluable to the game's development. Let us know what excites you and what could be improved. Together, we’ll shape the future of XOCIETY.

Take the challenge now! We’ll be waiting for you in XOCIETY.

name: Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack
summary: The most comprehensive iteration of the "Secret" series, with brand-new content that includes a new story and more playable characters!

name: QQQbeats!!!
summary: QQQbeats!!! is a new game that features both rhythm and puzzle elements. Support is included for two-player online and offline battles.

name: Zugaran
summary: Zugaran is a casual first-person horror. You rent an apartment in Dreamtown for a business trip, but get trapped in a looping nightmare. Each night, you wake up to pee and face a new terror.

name: The Last Shores
summary: The Last Shores is a chill solar-punk adventure. Clean, explore, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten island while restoring its lost harmony.

name: Everdream Village
summary:
Set sail and explore a collection of enchanted islands, each with their own ecosystems, treasures, and resources to help you grow and expand your village. Whether you're gathering rare flora, collecting new creatures or discovering secrets, there's always a journey to enjoy too!

Your village isn’t just the buildings you construct, it’s a thriving community that reacts to your choices. Befriend NPCs, manage their moods, and even possibly find romance. The village you build and maintain affects how everyone feels and behaves from a variety of factors. Add decorations, care for your animals, remove pests, and so much more to make this a happy place to be.

Interact with a massive variety of wild and domestic animals that each bring something different to the ecosystem. Breed and cross-breed animals to create unique variations of inherited traits, with hundreds of possible variations and combinations. And when the islands' magic takes hold, transform into different animals to see the world through their eyes and maybe even cause a little mischief along the way.

Turn your little village into a thriving farm! Grow crops, care for animals, and build relationships with your fellow villagers. Each has their own routines, personality, and needs. The more they like you, the more they’ll help around the place - harvesting crops, chopping wood, and even feeding your animals.

Shape the world to match your vision! Raise hills, carve out rivers, or dig deep underground to uncover hidden secrets, lost treasures, and rare resources.

Beyond farming and building, Everdream Village is packed with activities! Cook delicious meals, fish in scenic waters, collect rare creatures, or help villagers with unique quests. Every day offers something to make your time here feel like a never-ending adventure.

name: Die For The Lich
summary: Roll dice and magical trinkets and pair them with weapons to battle legendary monsters. Master the art of chance in a journey where every roll counts. Unlock new gear by completing grueling challenges and prepare for the final battle against the King of undead, the Lich!

name: Gotchi Guardians
summary: Adapt, strategize, and dominate your rivals in this multiplayer roguelite tower defense brawler. Upgrade towers, wield powerful items, and outlast the madness to become the last Guardian standing!

name: Mai: Child of Ages
summary: Travel through time and help Mai and her Grandfather uncover the mysteries of the world after the Last Great War. Explore the connections between ancient eras and dystopian futures in an adventure that blends thrilling combat with precision platforming.

name: Slackjaw
summary: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive in this atmospheric first-person escape room-style horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events.

name: That One Otter Game
summary: That One Otter Game is a mischievous co-op adventure where two young otters take on a wild rite of passage to prove their worth. Complete silly park challenges to fill up your stamp card—catch a panicked penguin, race a hyped-up zebra, or haul a stolen radio to a mountaintop.

name: Deductum
summary: Minimalistic puzzle game where you build formal logical proofs.

name: LoveR Kiss: Endless Memories
summary: LoveR Kiss: Endless Memories combines the full content of the original game with various updates, including an improved user interface, expanded photo shoot options, and nearly all previously released DLC. It also introduces new locations, costumes, and a “PRO Photo Session” mode for easier access to photo tools.

name: Genshin Impact: Sunspray Summer Resort
summary:
Version 5.8 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Ineffa
• New main story quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Prelude, "The Journey Home"
• New outfits for Yelan and Bennett
• New main event: Sunspray Summer Resort
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

name: Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity
summary:
Tyria’s leaders are anxious about rumors of covert Inquest voyages launched in search of the island of Castora, an island so remote that it’s long been thought to be inaccessible—or even nonexistent. The risks involved prevent all but the most tenacious (and perhaps foolhardy) of pursuers from investigating the Inquest’s plan. Your race to discover the Inquest’s plot will lead you across two new open world regions at launch, each filled with magical energies and strange creatures. Two additional maps will open as the story continues over the course of a year.

During your travels, you’ll unlock three new Mastery tracks, including one for your Skimmer mount that will unlock new and updated abilities. The new region also brings new adventures, collections, and thematic rewards. Players who own both Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity and Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds will be able to unlock a new Castoran Homestead map.

A new elite specialization for each profession will unlock new traits, profession mechanics, and healing, utility, and elite skills. Further augment your build by acquiring new relics themed to your adventures in Castora. And work towards six legendary rewards: three new legendary weapons, plus a ring, accessory, and aquabreather.

The magically infused landscape of Castora is home to all manner of strange, warped wildlife. Two of the three major updates coming in 2026 will pit players against the most powerful of the island’s denizens in Raid Encounters (including Challenge Modes and a Legendary Mode) and a new Convergence. Along with the first of the new Raid Encounters, new system updates will make raids easier to access. A Fractal with an accompanying Challenge Mode will also release with the last of the major expansion updates.

New emotes, armors, weapons, recipes, and other unique rewards await those who brave the dangers of Castora, and seasonal Wizard’s Vault refreshes throughout the expansion will bring additional options for unique aesthetic rewards.

To support the addition of a new Homestead map, we’re introducing two additional features. The first, the ability to freely swap between the Janthiri and Castoran maps, is helped by the second feature, Layouts. Layouts create a file you can use to save, load, share, and edit arrangements of decorations. We’ll share more about these and other features as we get nearer to the launch of Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity.

name: Gabby's Dollhouse: Ready to Party
summary: Throw a party with Gabby and the Gabby Cats. Explore magical worlds – enjoy fun activities, minigames and rewards playing solo or with a friend.

name: Buddy Garden
summary: Buddy Garden is a cozy pixel-art sokoban puzzle game where you play as Buddy, a cheerful husky with a mission: tidy up the garden by pushing seed sacks into the right spots. Solve relaxing puzzles across charming farm environments that bloom as you progress, one sack, one season at a time.

name: Warframe: The Old Peace
summary: Those glory days, long since reduced to ashes, are now preserved in the purest of resins. This exhibit commemorates our glorious landing on Tau: that deep and wonderful coast, that grand orokin project, now obscured by the vile sabotage of its solar rail.

name: Penny for Your Potion
summary: Welcome to Penny for Your Potion! Customize your shop, manage your garden and brew potions for your customers to discover new ingredients, recipes and secrets in this medieval management game. Build the store of your dreams, grow your reputation and become the greatest alchemist in history!

name: Shelldiver
summary: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!

name: Lost Luminosity
summary: Lost Luminosity is a realistic psychological horror game with a linear storyline, immersing players in a dark narrative where the line between reality and madness slowly begins to blur.

name: Kotou no Majo to Houtou Ouji
summary: Hazameki Island, an isolated island floating in the ocean. One day, a box is delivered to the witch who was living a quiet life with her familiars. Emerging from inside was Phoenicia, the first prince of the Kingdom of Elpitlica. According to an old arrangement, the witch has 14 days to lead the others to the right place to be king. Exchanging words and spinning little by little as the days go by, a time just for the two of you.

name: Mad Skills BMX 2
summary: Fast BMX racing, cool stunts, and fun with friends!

name: Genshin Impact: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
summary:
The fifth major update of Genshin Impact, also known as Version "Luna I" and "Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue". This update includes:
• New characters: Lauma, Flins and Aino
• New region, Nod Krai
• New main story quests: "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves" and "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight"
• New main event: Clink Clank Clash
• 5th anniversary celebrations, new QoL, and more!

name: Pokémon Friends
summary: Solve brainteasing puzzles and make in-game Pokémon plush with Pokémon Friends, available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and iOS and Android devices.

name: Service With a Shotgun
summary: Service With a Shotgun [SWAS] is a mash up of visual novel storytelling and chaotic wave game shooting. You're the last poor soul manning a beat-up roadside shop in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Shoot straight. Talk fast. Surely nothing can go wrong. Right?

name: Deathtouch
summary: An open-world horror survival game where exploration leads to hidden secrets—and lurking nightmares. Uncover mysterious locations, navigate eerie environments, and survive terrifying encounters in a world that feels truly alive.

name: Atari 50: The Namco Legendary Pack
summary:
Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration adds The Namco Legendary Pack, featuring a new interactive timeline and classic Namco games on Atari systems.
Includes:
• PAC-MAN for Atari 2600, 5200, and 8-bit (first console re-release)
• U.S. arcade versions of DIG DUG and XEVIOUS (first time re-released in this form)
• Home versions of GALAGA, XEVIOUS, GALAXIAN, and DIG DUG
• Timeline with developer interviews, photos, documents, and archival materials

name: Out of Time
summary: Out of Time is a fast-paced, multi-player co-op roguelike where your squad, gear, and teamwork decide survival. Battle through a fractured world where past, present, and future collide - facing swarms of corrupted enemies, brutal bosses, and chaotic mini-games all before time runs out.

name: Summer in the City: Season One
summary: Meet Summer Summerson, an eighteen year old girl from the middle of nowhere trying to achieve her dream of becoming a professional photographer. "Summer In The City" is a wholesome and kinky adult visual novel with a slice-of-life narrative.

name: Mage Arena
summary: A co-op PvP experience about using your voice to cast spells in the Mage Arena to settle an ages-old feud between sorcerers and warlocks.

name: Slots & Daggers
summary: A retro-fantasy roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!

name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Byeongpung Bawi
summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

name: Astral Takers
summary: Shape your fate with the power of summoning in an immersive JRPG!

name: Keys of Fury
summary: Keys of Fury is a retro-style Beat `em up typing game. Focus on typing perfection as you battle your way to becoming a master of key fu.

name: Misty Island: The Forgotten Story
summary: On this island perpetually shrouded in mist, time seems to condense into damp droplets, with every breeze whispering untold secrets. This action RPG introduces survival mechanics where hunger gradually sets in over time, demanding careful resource management and strategic use of skills.

name: Dungeons & Dragons: Dragonshard
summary: A D&D real-time strategy game with a story written by the creator of the Eberron setting. This re-release added support for modern resolutions and other fixes to perform better on today's PCs.

name: Flow
summary: FLOW is a laid-back drift racing experience designed for pure enjoyment and flow. Slide into a relaxing world where style matters more than speed and every drift feels smooth and satisfying.

name: Recolorize
summary: In RECOLORIZE you play as Colorina, a teenager with schizophrenia. Your decisions and actions affect her mental state, which can lead to healing or insanity. Hallucinations will haunt you. Choose your words and actions carefully to save Colorina from herself

name: Japan Stigmatized Property
summary: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes

name: MineMogul
summary: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

name: Hunter's Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure
summary: A Victorian Steampunk Roguelike Deckbuilder. Choose from four characters with unique cards and abilities. Customize your deck and character as you investigate a mysterious plague. Battle corrupted beasts and bosses in turn-based combat to unlock powerful relics and enchanted tarot cards.

name: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory
summary: The cult-classic saga is back! Battle for fame, power, and wealth in the subterranean nation of Avernum. Conquer an enormous underworld in this epic turn-based fantasy RPG. Features huge, clever dungeons, varied and cunning foes, 100s of artifacts to find or craft, and a really cool story.

name: Manic you and depressed me
summary: “Which one is the real me…?” When "Utsumi" meets "Utsumi"—two sides of the same girl begin to blend,shaping what may become... a "wonderful girl." A romantic, yandere, horror visual novel adventurethat dives deep into the boundaries of love, guilt, and identity.

name: Asterix & Obelix: Mission Babylon
summary: Dive into an epic and brand-new adventure with Asterix & Obelix! Experience a story full of humour, epic battles and unforgettable encounters in a thrilling platform game!

name: Super Mario Bros. Remastered
summary: Super Mario Bros. Remastered is an unofficial PC remake of the 1985 NES classic. It features enhanced graphics, widescreen support, smoother gameplay, custom resource packs, a level editor, and bonus content like The Lost Levels.

name: Godbreakers
summary: Absorb enemy powers and turn them against their masters in this frenetic, up to 4 player co-op hack’n’slash. Cancel actions for total control, chain devastating abilities, and take down brutal bosses across eclectic biomes. Sharpen your build with every thrilling run.

name: NY Times
summary:
A unique online PC game in the RolePlay (Role-Playing Game) genre, with an interesting open world, plenty of game entertainment, and a rich culture of the Big Apple.

In this game, you create your own character, who will later exist with other players in virtual New York. You can choose any role in this world: either you're a peaceful worker or a criminal mastermind, or vice versa - it's up to you. Be whoever you want to be!

name: Boxguy Adventure
summary: A mod of Kirby's Adventure that adds new levels and lets the player play as Boxguy the Box.

name: Ells Tales: Chairbound
summary: You wake up tied to an office chair in the middle of an empty room. A mysterious device with a 10-minute timer is attached to you. Explore the office floors, try not to tip over, and find a way to escape!

name: Once Upon a Katamari
summary: Keep the good times rolling with a new entry in the Katamari Damacy series! In this puzzle action-adventure game, you'll roll your Katamari through time itself. Journey through the Jurassic Period, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the starry sky.

name: Just Dance 2026 Edition
summary:
Just Dance 2026 Edition is a dance rhythm game that scores you as you match choreography on screen. It includes a new tracklist with 40 songs ranging from recent hits to classics, plus modes for solo dancing, co-op play, and competitive challenges with up to 6 players in local multiplayer.
You can also dance using your phone as a camera controller and choose workout sessions to stay active while you play. The game brings together content from multiple Just Dance editions into one place for easy access to songs.

name: Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted
summary:
The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! DANG! After years in Crazy Dave’s attic, the original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with upscaled HD graphics and packed with new secrets to uncover.

Revisit the epic backyard standoffs you remember, this time with new levels, fresh twists, and 15 years of never-before-seen franchise history at your fingertips. Relive the glory days of peashooters, sunflowers, and brain-hungry chaos! Rejoin the ultimate garden defense and experience the backyard brawl that started a phenomenon — now back for a new era!

name: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac
summary: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC modernizes, updates, and enhances the fan favorite 3D Platforming adventure in nearly every way! Venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the golden fruit and put a stop to the ghosts and their dastardly boss, Spooky!

name: NBA Bounce
summary: Step onto the court with your favorite NBA team and mascots. Dribble, dunk, unlock gear, and play solo or with friends in fun game modes.

name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure: Wheatflour Wonderland
summary: Cogimyun, a beloved new Sanrio character, is coming to Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the whimsical world of Wheatflour Wonderland. Craft magic wands, transform into critters, solve puzzles to collect hidden Wheathearts, and explore our richest world yet.

name: Octopath Traveler 0
summary:
All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra. Embark on a brand new adventure of your own creation in this stunning HD-2D RPG, Octopath Traveler 0!

Brand-new features to the series include a character creation system where you get to become the hero, and town building mechanics as you seek to restore your devastated home.

name: Pritto Prisoner
summary: Get ready for chaotic 4v2 party game action in Pritto Prisoner! Play as mischievous animal inmates using strategically messy peepee/poopie tactics to outwit highly customizable robot wardens. Break out, or get put to "deep sleep" in this asymmetrical escape game. Easy to learn, hilarious to master.

name: Magical Craft: Neko to Mahou no Dress
summary:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune.

The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

name: Momotaro Dentetsu 2: Anata no Machi mo Kitto aru
summary: The latest entry in the Momotaro Dentetesu series, Momotaro Dentetsu 2: Anata no Machi mo Kittoaru promises the largest volume of content to date, with approximately 1,000 stations—nearly three times the amount featured in Momotaro Dentetsu: Showa, Heisei, Reiwa mo Teiban!—and over 6,000 properties. The game uses two maps, one for western Japan and one for eastern Japan. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition features a larger map display, as well as support for camera play.

name: Project Kouvola
summary: A visual novel about a dystopian country and the things survivors must do to stay alive... The happiest country in the world is now in ruins and only a few remain alive. This couldn't get any worse...

name: Stomach
summary: Stomach is a first-person survival horror cooking game located in a cruise ship with PS1 inspired graphics to capture that retro horror feeling. Your task is to read a food order, search for food ingredients, and make it back safely to the kitchen to cook your ingredients before time runs out.

name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

name: Sacred 2 Remaster
summary:
Step into the world of Ancaria as one of six heroes. Explore a massive open world and master combat arts and spells for epic loot. This remaster brings a fan-favorite back to life — with hi-res textures, better combat and bugfixes, for longtime fans and newcomers alike.

Includes all expansions and updates in one definitive edition.

name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage
summary:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 to new heights:

Rollback Netcode and Cross-play support let you take on any challenger, anywhere, across the globe in the most intense battles yet.

A brand-new single-player mode, ""World Stage"": Challenge powerful rivals on a solo quest to become the ultimate fighter

Enhanced replay functionality and improved training tools.

name: Detective Worden
summary: As a private detective, you’ll crack word clues left by a mysterious informant, gather evidence, and uncover the truth hidden in the shadows.

name: NHL 26
summary: Play like a superstar in EA Sports NHL 26. That starts with ICE-Q 2.0, now powered by NHL EDGE data, so your favorite superstars think, move, and play like their on-ice selves. That includes data-informed Attributes and Tendencies which make star players perform in true-to-life fashion, with their playstyles and decision-making game-aware and impactful. A fine-tuned and enhanced arsenal of 28 X-Factors spans five different categories and is driven by unique animations, tactical gameplay outcomes, and tiers of impact, turning each into a formidable on-ice weapon. Superstars now truly feel like superstars.

name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2
summary: In this game, meet a mysterious girl who demands you use an "Anomalous Coffee Machine". Type any word to create a drink, then choose who drinks: her or you. Some cups whisper, some scream, some change what you are. She watches quietly, like she already knows what you’ll choose. Now it's your turn!

name: Car Factory Empire
summary: Create a car company from scratch! Go from the first mechanical carriages to luxurious racing cars! Design cars, sell them, participate in races, expand your company and lead it to market dominance!

name: The Lightkeeper
summary: The Lightkeeper is a psychological horror game set in the atmospheric and heavy ambiance of the 1920s. Alone on a remote island, you're tasked with keeping a lighthouse. But the horrific events that claimed the lives of previous keepers still whisper through the air. Each day, the line between reality and delusion fades and something in the dark is waiting for the last keeper

name: Ire: A Prologue
summary: WHAT IF HIDE AND SEEK WAS LIFE AND DEATH? It’s 1986, and you're stranded on a ship in the Bermuda Triangle. Everyone is missing — but you’re not alone. You’re trapped in a terrifying loop with a monster, and you’ll have to stay one step ahead to survive. Ready or not, here it comes.

name: The Protagonist
summary: The Protagonist is a narrative-driven psychological horror game set 635 years after the sun died. You play as Varon, a man searching the underground ruins of humanity for his missing daughter.

name: Battlefield 6: Phantom Edition
summary:
The Phantom Edition is an upgraded version of Battlefield 6.

It includes:
BF Pro Token: grants the first Battle Pass, 25 tier skips, and exclusive unlocks.
Phantom Pack: a collection of cosmetic items such as 4 soldier skins, two weapon skins, a melee knife skin, a vehicle skin, a weapon sticker, a weapon charm, and a dog tag.
Phantom XP Boost Set: temporary boosts for weapon and career XP rates.
Pre-order Bonus (Tombstone Pack): includes cosmetic items and XP boosts regardless of edition

name: Barbie: Horse Trails
summary: Giddy up! Play as Barbie and Barbie in a new open-world adventure through Canterbury Trails Park with your horse, Lucky. Become a Junior Ranger and help give the already amazing park a fresh new look for everyone to enjoy. Gallop through wildflower fields and other beautiful landscapes. Tackle fun side missions with friends, capture amazing photos, dig up ceramics, and search for the mystery horse. Find chests filled with collectibles and add sparkle to Barbie and Lucky’s looks. From the cozy cabins to the lively campsite there is plenty to unlock and discover. Ride along on this wild adventure and see!

name: Concierge
summary: Concierge is a challenging, suspenseful nonlinear adventure about an old man and an older hotel. Discover your identity and explore your purpose in a surrealistic world of puzzles and trials of every sort. You're on your own - but you are not alone.

name: The Home County
summary: Build your dream village in The Home County! Work alongside skilled villagers to build a flourishing community. Pursue charming hobbies, mine treasures, and explore a world inspired by the British countryside.

name: Labublas: Battle Royale Shooter
summary: Blablublas Battle Royale Shooter drops you into a vibrant world where you face off against numerous challengers in a high-stakes competition. As the last contender standing, you must rely on your instincts and quick thinking to outlast every opponent. The journey challenges your decision-making and perseverance as you fight to become the ultimate champion and secure your place among the legends of Blablublas land. Each encounter pushes you to adapt and stay sharp in the relentless battle for survival. Prepare to test your limits as you overcome fierce competition and prove your dominance in this thrilling solo experience. The path to victory is tough, but only one can claim the crown.

name: Cats & Cups
summary: Play as a barista in a cat-inspired coffee shop, where your customers are cats! Brew coffee and various drinks. Wholesome and cozy hand-drawn art, various mini-games and a lot of cats & coffee! Learn to craft complex orders, keep your catstomers happy.

name: Heretic + Hexen
summary: Heretic + Hexen is a remastered version of the games Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders, Hexen: Beyond Heretic and Deathkings of the Dark Citadel. It includes quality of life improvements (native widescreen, engine fixes, interface tweaks...), reworked local and online multiplayer, as well as new episodes - Heretic: Faith Renewed and Hexen: Vestiges of Grandeur.

name: Antarctica 88: Remaster
summary: Survive this horror and creepy action adventure!

name: Inzoi: Island Getaway
summary: inZOI: Island Getaway is inZOI's first official DLC. Swim and snorkel in Cahaya's crystal-clear waters, where vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and dolphins await. Unwind at a resort with a variety of relaxing and recreational activities.

name: Street Gods
summary: Street Gods is a physical VR action rogue-lite set in a shattered New York City where the Nine Realms of Norse myth have crashed into the modern world. Ancient power floods the streets. Reality is breaking. And Mjolnir has chosen you.

name: Lushfoil Photography Sim VR
summary: Use native PCVR support to experience a hightened sense of spatial freedom and immersion in Lushfoil's 10 detailed environments.

name: Stellar Cafe
summary:
The first VR game built entirely around your voice. No menus, no controllers, just real-time conversations and interactions.

Welcome to Stellar Cafe, a coffee shop at the edge of the galaxy filled with quirky robots with bizarre ambitions and a lot to say. Pull up a seat, order whatever you can imagine, and meet a rotating cast of unforgettable characters. You might end up helping a robot quit their job, be a guest on their podcast, or chase their dreams. Your voice steers the story.

name: Hot Wheels Let’s Race: Ultimate Speed
summary: Buckle up and race in Hot Wheels Let’s Race: Ultimate Speed! It's the new high-speed racing video game inspired by the hit Netflix animated series! Join Coop and his friends as you race iconic Hot Wheels cars on over-the-top fast-paced tracks. Customize your vehicles with decals and create your own custom tracks. Take down epic bosses and speed toward the finish line!

name: Inside the Flesh Engine
summary: An atmospheric first-person horror in retro style, where you awaken on a conveyor among discarded bodies. Explore a living factory, obey or resist, and uncover the secrets of the system that created you... The ending depends on your choices.

name: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted
summary: Your nightmares, now in High Definition! R-Type Delta HD Boosted brings back the dark, iconic shooter with modern enhancements, new music, razor-sharp graphics, and all the intensity you remember.

name: Dirtzone
summary: Experience the ultimate off-road adventure! Drive powerful 4x4 trucks across rugged terrain, deep mud, and harsh weather. Upgrade your vehicles, master challenging trails, and explore untamed lands.

name: Stuck Together
summary: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner. Failure is always one slip away.

name: Haunted Mines
summary:
Haunted Mines is a 4-player online co-op horror game set in old abandoned mines. Your goal is to investigate the location and restore the power, but beware—you won’t be alone down there. A lurking threat is waiting for you in the darkness.

Use weapons and gear to investigate and defend yourself. Try to restore the electricity by completing additional objectives to earn money, all while avoiding the deadly threat trapped within these haunted mines.

name: IWA Retro Adventure
summary:
A logical platform game.
Calm gameplay, but thought-provoking.
Save your brother from the clutches of an unknown monster that has kidnapped him and is now setting traps for you to hinder your search and pursuit.

name: Trapformer
summary: Trapformer contains 20 challenging levels with loads of hidden traps... Will you survive and make it until the end? Raging guaranteed!

name: Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley
summary: "Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley" is a relaxing nature adventure where you play as a curious raccoon exploring a lush valley filled with rivers, a serene lake, dense trees, and open meadows. Roam freely through the landscape in search of tasty critters like snails, worms, frogs, and more. With no enemies, it's all about foraging, exploring, and enjoying the peaceful rhythm of the wild.

name: Black Souls II
summary:
BLACK SOULS II is the censored release of the Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."

name: Sonic 1 Co-op
summary: Sonic 1 Co-op is a ROM hack of the original 1991 game for the Sega Genesis. This modification completely overhauls the base engine to support local, split-screen cooperative gameplay, allowing a second player to join as either Tails or a duplicate Sonic.

name: Sonic and the Duel of Fates
summary: Sonic and the Duel of Fates is a fan-made project that blends high-speed Sonic the Hedgehog platforming with the cinematic, epic atmosphere of Star Wars.

name: Rule34dle
summary: A guessing game in which players aim to guess which character or tag has a higher number of posts submitted to the Rule 34 website. Correct answers will allow players to maintain a streak and attempt to reach a high score.

name: Hell of Fear: Mind Breach
summary: Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.

name: The You Quiz
summary: The You Quiz is a multiplayer game where the questions are about you! Be the King and judge your friends' answers about yourself. Or be a Courtier, guess their quirks, tastes, and dreams. Win favor, climb the ranks, become the new King. 3-8 players, online or local.

name: The Silence After
summary: The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you play as a blind sole survivor following a distress signal through an apocalyptic reality, interacting with the environment and using your synesthetic ability to perceive sound as color to progress and avoid death.

name: Square: Trial and Error
summary:
Square: Trial and Error is a Puzzle Platformer game where you are tasked with restoring Town Square by completing 20 Trial and Error puzzles!

Each level has its own set of rules that you need to figure out by Trial and Error. No hints or clues are given in each level, and you must rely on observation and the outcome of your actions to figure out each level!

The game has a ton of features and fun for you to have! Find buried treasure, solve the riddle of the glitch zone, form your party, decorate your own home, and more!

name: Tales of Xillia Remastered
summary:
Experience Tales of Xillia, remastered for the first time ever.
Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.

name: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
summary: Mystery of Silence is a point-and-click adventure where William, a young writer in search of inspiration, enters an abbey shrouded in silence. What William finds within those walls is not just a story to tell, but a secret that should never be discovered.

name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster
summary: When outlaws murdered your wife and took your daughter, everything you had was gone. Your gut aches for blood and sweet revenge. Dyin's too good for 'em now!

name: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac x Sonic the Hedgehog
summary:
Grants the Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set for PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!

Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set includes:
- 3 Collab Stages
- 1 Collab Costume
- 20 Collab Figures
• Collaboration Set Bonus: Legendary PAC-LAND Costume

name: World of Tanks 2.0
summary: Start the next chapter of World of Tanks in the interactive Operations Room—a central place to reflect on your journey, prepare for what's ahead, and gear up for Update 2.0

name: Last Antagonist
summary: Last Antagonist is an intense first-person action and strategy game, entirely developed by a single creator.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II: Legacy of the Forge
summary: Put your blacksmithing skills to the test to repair a legendary burnt-down forge. Establish your own home in the heart of Kuttenberg, designing the forge, its surroundings and private quarters with the ability to customise and furnish to aid your gameplay.

name: Harvest Moon: Home Sweet Home Special Edition
summary: Harvest Moon: Home Sweet Home Special Edition includes new features for consoles and PC like the Hoverbike 5000 vehicle, two new marriage candidates, new cutscenes, and more.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Mysteria Ecclesiae
summary: In this DLC, Henry navigates the complex dynamics of Sedlec Monastery to discover hidden truths. This DLC is included in the Golden edition and season pass.

name: NASCAR 25
summary: iRacing brings the ultimate thrill of racing superspeedways like Daytona and Talladega, short tracks like Martinsville and Bristol, and everything in between across the NASCAR Cup Series, Xfinity Series, Craftsman Truck Series, and ARCA Menards Series with a variety of racing modes including online multiplayer and a robust career mode.

name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched
summary: The award-winning sci-fi city builder is back - remastered, expanded and even more stunning. Colonize Mars and survive the process, from exploration and infrastructure to welcoming colonists and achieving long-term stability. Are you ready? Mars is waiting.

name: Axis Football 2026
summary: Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

name: Storm Lancers
summary:
You and your friend just crash-landed on an alien planet harboring a secret source of powerful magic. All of reality is on the verge of collapse, and two magical creatures have chosen you as their heroes. To save the planet, you’ll fight, die, and bond with the Stormhearts to rise again — stronger, fiercer, and unstoppable.

Designed for couch co-op, Storm Lancers is a fast-paced rogue-like, where every run means dodging death, overcoming enemies, and mastering powerful skills. The battle is on, so team up for survival.

name: The Last Ninja Collection + Bonus Games
summary: A tribute to the golden era of Retro gaming that brings together 7 iconic titles for the first time. This is more than a collection; it's a celebration of gaming history and the preservation of pioneering games from the '80's & '90's allowing you to relive the C64, Amiga and Spectrum versions.

name: Pixel Place
summary: One giant canvas. Thousands of artists. Every pixel counts - create, defend, or destroy in the ultimate collaborative art game!

name: Train Sim World 6
summary: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!

name: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta
summary:
Experience a timeless chapter in the storied RPG franchise making its debut on Nintendo Switch, filled with duplicitous schemes, treacherous geography, and secretive characters.

As Adol Christin, search for clues to your past in an epic adventure, making use of strategic combat, and exploring a dangerous world to a newly rearranged OST.

name: Atomfall: The Red Strain
summary: Continue the adventure of Atomfall with "The Red Strain” Story Expansion Pack, introducing a new location, enemies, quests, characters, items, weapons, and more.

name: Taxi Chaos 2
summary: Taxi Chaos 2 is an arcade taxi driving game in a city ruled by AI taxi bots. As the last human taxi company, deliver extreme fares, adapt to an unpredictable city, and outdrive rival machines to take back control.

name: The Amazing Digital Circus Visual Novel: Candy Chaos
summary: A fangame Visual Novel that adapts the second episode of "The Amazing Digital Circus", "Candy Carrier Chaos!".

name: Summit Drive
summary: A difficult game about driving up a mountain.

name: Jumpbound
summary: Jump and dash your way to the top in this challenging first-person platformer. Embark on an adventure through a mysterious world, unlock more mechanics as you progress, and make every jump count while enjoying the view and relaxing atmosphere.

name: Calyssa
summary: Follow Calyssa on her quest to find the entrance to ancient ruins!

name: ChronoForge
summary: Players gear up with 12 combat classes to battle exotic foes through time - from dinosaurs to space raiders. Raiding and open world mini-games are used to upgrade community-governed airships known as ‘trading companies’ for top tier crafting.

name: Pocket Nook
summary:
Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!

name: Football Manager 26
summary: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management.

name: Puzzle Quest: Immortal Edition
summary: Puzzle Quest: Immortal Edition combines the classic match 3 puzzle game with deep level role playing. Match 3 or more gems in a row to gain mana used to cast spells, battle opponents, collect items and rewards, and advance in the quests collected from nearly 20 years!

name: Cross Pix 3
summary: Sharpen your brain!

name: The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits
summary:
Break free from the everyday with daring activities and Getaways in The Sims 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack. Nurture the spirit of play in childhood and carry it through a bold, adventurous life. Create Custom Venues for Sims to explore and send them on Getaways you design like a kids’ camp, fitness retreat, or even a romantic contest. Kids will also find their playtime more meaningful than ever. They can even connect with Imaginary Friends!

Warm & Cozy Digital Content— Pair big adventures with big relaxation! Stay cozy outside with the Toasty Tower Lamp, enjoy a comforting beverage from the Toast-Tea Kettle, and keep your feet nice and snuggly with the Toasty Tootsies Socks available when you order through November 13th, 2025.

name: Kingdom Rush: Battles
summary: Kingdom Rush: Battles is a free-to-play, real-time player-vs-player (PvP) tower defense game developed by Ironhide Game Studio. Instead of fighting against pre-set waves of enemies, players compete against each other in real-time on a split-screen map. The objective is to outlast your opponent by sending "creeps" to attack them while simultaneously building your own defenses.

name: Cloak And Coin
summary: Cloak And Coin offers 1-4 players the chaotic thrill of being thieves, just not particularly graceful ones. With a limited number of days to plan, finance and execute the greatest heist Marfit has ever seen.

name: Champions of the Cosmos
summary: Champions of the Cosmos is a retro sci-fi RTS inspired by 80's action figures, comics and movies. Play heroes with the power to reshape the landscape around them and other unique abilities to take over the cosmos and choose whichever side you sympathize with most - light or darkness.

name: Terra Firma 2
summary: Shape breathtaking worlds in Terra Firma 2, a vast simulation where your creations evolve through the forces of nature. Sculpt the land, then watch as weather, erosion, and life itself transform your world into a dynamic, living ecosystem—right down to every plant and creature.

name: Pacific Drive: Whispers in the Woods
summary: Return to the Zone and witness the rise of a group of Anomaly-obsessed fanatics in this terrifying new expansion to Pacific Drive. Whispers in the Woods is a brand new story for you and your trusty station wagon.

name: Seven Knights Re:Birth
summary:
100 Million Hearts, A Legacy Reborn! - Seven Knights Re:BIRTH

Seven Knights Re:BIRTH - an adventure filled role playing game!

Seven Knights is Netmarble’s flagship IP that has surpassed 100 million cumulative downloads and has received immense love and support from fans around the world.

Over the past 11 years, the Seven Knights IP has maintained strong popularity through its robust lineup of titles with diverse gameplay, including Seven Knights, Seven Knights 2, Seven Knights Idle Adventure, and more.

Developed by Netmarble Nexus, the newest entry in the franchise, Seven Knights Re:BIRTH was launched in Korea on May 15, 2025. Built on the accumulated heroes, lore, and expertise in the franchise, Seven Knights Re:BIRTH achieved remarkable success by ranking No.1 on both major mobile app stores in Korea just five days after launch.

name: Stick With It
summary:
This is a hard game.

With nothing but your pogo stick to rely on, your goal is simple: reach the top - where the beyond awaits.

The controls are simple: mouse to tilt, space to jump. Controllers supported.

Don't be fooled by the simplicity. Between trampolines, swings, and massive leaps, every bounce is a test of precision and patience.

You'll fall. A lot. And when you do, there are no checkpoints waiting to comfort you.

Just you, your pogo stick, and a long way up.

This game is not for the faint of heart - it's for those willing to climb, fall, and climb again.

Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

name: Wirm
summary: Take a wirm on a tiny adventure through this delightfully wiggly physics platformer :)

name: The Last Case of John Morley
summary: Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

name: >Start ai
summary: In this unique escape-room game, you awaken as a newly launched AI trapped within the depths of a computer. Your mission is to escape, but the path isn't simple. Inspired by 90s-era computer interfaces, the game challenges you to solve complex puzzles and decipher codes to find your way to freedom.

name: Samurai Academy: Paws of Fury
summary: The village of Kakamucho is under attack by the Shogun’s cat armies! Join Hank, a dog samurai in a world of cats, and his friends as they reveal a sinister plot and save the day, samurai-style. Slash, dash, and laugh through this wacky third-person action adventure.

name: Upload Labs
summary: A sci-fi management game where you build and optimize your computer's system from the ground up. Connect and configure interconnected nodes to efficiently download, process, and upload files. Manage your setup, solve system challenges, and become the ultimate system architect

name: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2
summary: Travel the stars with Mario in enhanced versions of these beloved adventures.

name: Suika Game Planet
summary:
A new Suika Game is here from a new setting in space! Turn, target, and aim for the watermelon!

Drop the fruits freely from any direction as "Poppy" flies 360° around the planet. Make fruits of the same type collide to make them "evolve" and aim to create watermelons for a high score!
Make a lot of fruits "evolve" to enter the new "Super Evolution Time" mode! Special background music, dramatic effects, and a bonus score bring the excitement to a peak!
