The "Suika Game Planet" has evolved in many ways, including with a customization function that allows you to freely decorate the game screen (skin), and a collection function that allows you to collect stickers for completing missions and use them to create your original name tag. Try playing it now!

name: Donkey Kong Bananza: DK Island & Emerald Rush
summary: Sightsee across this modern take on Donkey Kong’s home, packed with nostalgic views like DK’s Treehouse, Gangplank Galleon, and other iconic locations. Take in-game photos with familiar friends Diddy Kong, Dixie Kong, Cranky Kong, and Rambi, and Squawks, and decorate DK Island with DLC-exclusive character statues that you can obtain with Banandium Chips. You might even find some hidden bonus stages among the mine cart tracks and jungle ruins!

name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A - Mega Dimension
summary: Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a space known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the mythical Pokémon Hoopa might have some part to play.

name: Super Mario Galaxy
summary: This second Nintendo Switch port of Super Mario Galaxy was released standalone and contains differences from the Super Mario 3D All-Stars version, such as an Assist Mode and extra pages in Rosalina's Storybook.

name: Super Mario Galaxy 2
summary: The version of Super Mario Galaxy 2 released as part of the Super Mario Bros. 40th Anniversary contains added features like an Assist Mode and the addition of Rosalina's Storybook.

name: LinkedIn or Interpol
summary: LinkedIn or Interpol is a guessing game in which players are shown photographs and must determine whether the person pictured is a LinkedIn professional or a wanted criminal listed by Interpol.

name: Hunt Grounds
summary: Hunt Grounds is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game

name: Myrk: Echoes of the Forgotten
summary:
Awaken the Scions. Reclaim the Elements. Unravel forgotten prophecy.

Step into the realm of MYRK: Echoes of the Forgotten, a story-rich RPG where elemental chaos has fractured the cosmos. Once guided by balance and prophecy, the world now lies in turmoil. You are one of the last Scions—beings chosen by fate to rise from centuries of slumber and confront the aftermath of the First Collapse

name: Maimai DX Circle
summary: This brand new upgrade lets you join Circles and compete in Circle Festas.

name: Pokémon Añil: Definitive Edition
summary: Is an updated version of the popular fan game Pokémon Indigo created by EricLostie. This enhanced version was created by DPertierra and Skyflyer, and brings numerous improvements to the game.

name: Football Manager 26 Touch
summary: Football Manager 26 Touch launches digitally on December 4th.

name: Cling to Blindness
summary: Abide by three rules. 1. Never remove your blindfold. 2. Don't let Ashioto catch up to you. 3. Collect all five talisman. Cover your eyes, trust your ears, and...Cling to Blindness.

name: It Takes a War
summary: Graphics! Guns! Glory! Get ready to drop into a devastatingly real depiction of the battlefield as you and your team take on a relentless foe. It Takes a War presents a new vision for the team-based tactical shooter genre.

name: Zombie Ship
summary: A cinematic horror adventure where you battle undead horrors aboard a cursed warship. Explore, fight, and survive as the ocean itself turns against you in this atmospheric, story-driven experience.

name: Baroque-Ya
summary:
Baroque-Ya is a collection from Japanese developer and publisher Sting, bringing together four titles from the company's post-apocalyptic Baroque series for the Nintendo Switch.
This collection brings together four distinct titles from the series' history:
BAROQUE: Original Version: The game that started it all. This is the original 1998 version of the 3D dungeon-crawling RPG, where players guide an amnesiac protagonist through the ever-changing Neuro Tower to atone for a forgotten sin.

BAROQUE Syndrome: A prequel to the main story, originally released as a visual novel in 2000. This game delves into the lives of the characters and the events that led to the world-altering catastrophe known as the Great Heat Wave.

BAROQUE Shooting: Reversed: An updated release of the 2000 PC spin-off. This title is a 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up, offering a fast-paced, action-oriented take on the Baroque universe.

BAROQUE Become a Meta-Being Revive: An updated version of the 2022 arcade-style game. In this Frogger-esque title, players take on the role of a Meta-Being, navigating obstacles to survive in the distorted world.

name: Legend of Ymir
summary:
Legend of YMIR is a free-to-play, MMORPG inspired by Norse mythology, available on PC and mobile platforms.

Experience the awe-inspiring details of Norse mythology brought to life with Unreal Engine 5. Step into a vivid and immersive world where ancient legends come alive.

Each season introduces new battlefields, stories, enemies, and events. Escape the monotony of fixed systems and embrace the ever-evolving combat that changes moment by moment.

Feel the thrill at your fingertips with intricate controls and convenient automatic systems, redefining the excitement of combat through an immersive hit-confirmation system and evade controls.

Your adventures, your choices. Every action and decision shapes your path, carving out your own unique journey. Start an adventure that begins with you and create a story that only you can tell.

name: Agreeee
summary: Can you 'play' this game!? To play the thrilling action game, you must agree to all 12 terms and conditions.

name: Junji Ito Maniac: An Infinite Gaol
summary: Junji Ito Maniac: An Infinite Gaol is a first-person survival horror game inspired by Junji Ito's psychological horror and eerie aesthetics. This work centers on the twisted potential of human nature and fear of the unknown, taking you on a journey of survival where memory and mystery intertwine.

name: Winterlight: Where Silence Says It All
summary: As Elias returns to the coastal town that once sheltered him, he’s pulled into a slow winter of connection, memory and quiet decisions. Take the role of this young man and guide the choices he makes, surrounded by the warmth of townspeople young and old, often holding conversations in a bookstore over shared coffee.

name: Leaks In Space
summary: Build your own spaceship. Protect ship's core, manage Hull & Pressure to survive. Fight pirates. Explore themed sectors of the Syntar System. Uncover the mysterious of the Syntarian Empire!

name: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
summary: Do you have what it takes to bowl with the greats? PBA Pro Bowling is back and better than ever with a reimagined Career Mode, character customization, new character art, improved graphics, online play, advanced physics, and oil pattern breakdown - plus new game modes, venues, pros, balls, and more!

name: Truck Driver: The Dutch Connection
summary: Set in a reimagined Netherlands in 2027, discover a new era of trucking where AI dispatchers work alongside human drivers and the industry is thriving. Join Lucas and Felix as they face new challenges, forge alliances, and adapt to an evolving industry in this next chapter of the Truck Driver series.

name: Let It Die: Inferno
summary:
LET IT DIE: INFERNO is a roguelite survival action game where you can engage in chaotic battles with grotesque monsters, enemy factions, and even other players.

Humanity had just recovered from the unprecedented cataclysm known as “Earth Rage,” when suddenly, a massive chasm appeared—large enough to swallow an entire city whole.​ Someone began calling the hole “Hell Gate,” and lying at its depths is the “Eye of the Reaper,” a powerful crystal containing the energy to rule the world. Explore, survive, and extract from the Inferno, where stage layouts and item placements differ every match.

In this game, on top of player-versus-environment-versus-player—where players and enemies collide within Hell Gate—there is also a mode for battling exclusively with other players. We hope you enjoy this powered-up version of the LET IT DIE world!

name: Tekken 3
summary:
A port of Tekken 3, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Nineteen years following the previous King of Iron Fist tournament, fighters from all over the world have mysteriously begun to disappear at the hands of the enigmatic being known only as Toshin. Heihachi, hoping the promise of strong opponents will lure out this so-called "God of Fighting," begins his preparations for The King of Iron Fist Tournament 3.

name: SoulCalibur III
summary:
A port of SoulCalibur III, originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Soulcalibur III is a fighting game, the sequel to Soulcalibur II, and the fourth installment in the Soul series. Compared to its predecessor, it introduces three new modes and a larger character roster, with 24 characters playable in Tales of Souls mode and an additional 18 playable in all other modes.

name: Tomb Raider: Anniversary
summary:
This is an emulation of the classic PS2 action-adventure title, Tomb Raider: Anniversary, playable on PS4 and PS5 for the first time and enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Tomb Raider: Anniversary is a third-person action-adventure game that revisits Lara Croft’s original journey to recover the Scion artifact. It reimagines the 1996 title with updated environments, refined controls, and expanded narrative elements while maintaining the exploration, platforming, and combat of the original game.

name: Gran Turismo 7: Spec III
summary: The free Spec III Update 1.65* brings an exciting mix of high-performance machines, classic icons, and cutting-edge technology to Gran Turismo. From Ferrari’s latest track-bred GT3 to Polestar’s electric powerhouse, plus new circuits, events, and features, there’s something for every racing enthusiast.**

name: Fire Emblem Shadows
summary:
The gameplay of Fire Emblem Shadows combines real-time strategy and social deduction.

One of the three allies participating in each battle is secretly a treacherous disciple of shadow. Players choose to take on the role of either a disciple of light, aiming to find their way through the labyrinth, or a disciple of shadow.

After the initial battle, players vote to determine who they believe is the treacherous disciple of shadow. The outcome of the vote affects whether the next battle is more favorable or more challenging. Whether the disciples of light can correctly discover the traitor—or the disciple of shadow can successfully deceive the others—holds the key to how the next battle unfolds.

name: Orchard Odyssey: Cherry Chase
summary: In Orchard Odyssey: Cherry Chase, you guide Aurora through a single vibrant orchard level to collect cherries. You can run, jump, and unlock new abilities like double jump or enhanced map vision. The map is semi-procedural being shuffled every time you enter the Orchard.

name: Skullbreaker
summary: Skullbreaker is an Arkanoid game where you have to help the skeleton return to the tower and regain its rightful place at the top

name: Messenger
summary: Ever dreamt of having a job where you deliver mail to the residents of a tiny planet? Us too.

name: A Game About Feeding A Black Hole
summary: A short incremental game about feeding a Black Hole matter by destroying Asteroids, Planets, and Stars.

name: Q-Up
summary: Sick of long queues, unfair matchups, and arbitrary reflex tests? Try Q-UP, the coin flipping eSport. It's one part clicker, one part multiplayer strategy game, one part demented capitalism simulator, and 100% completely random.

name: Real Bout Fatal Fury 2: The Newcomers
summary: 1998 arcade fighter REAL BOUT FATAL FURY 2: THE NEWCOMERS is now on Steam! Featuring the largest roster in the series, 23 characters are back and ready to GET IN THE RING! Also with rollback netcode and a host of new features!

name: Blood: Refreshed Supply
summary: Things are about to get… bloody! Soak up 42 pulse-pounding levels dripping with Lovecraftian atmosphere as you battle your way through armies of sycophantic cultists, zombies, gargoyles, hell hounds, and other insatiable horrors, in your quest to defeat the loathsome Tchernobog.

name: Yakuza Kiwami & Yakuza Kiwami 2 Bundle
summary: A bundle including Yakuza Kiwami and Yakuza Kiwami 2.

name: Enshrined: Sword of Fates
summary: Once every 100 years, a temple containing a legendary blade appears for only 24 hours. The sword’s power can only be unlocked joining in body and spirit with another, and there are three men hoping to be chosen to share the sword’s power with you. Who will it be?

name: Five Hearts Under One Roof 2
summary: Boarding house owner Yuman is back! Alongside Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung, a wealthy heiress, a girl burdened by childhood scars, and a sweet nurse move in. In this house of old memories and new emotions, who will you fall in love with?

name: Age of Wonders 4: Thrones of Blood
summary: Embrace the night in Age of Wonders 4: Thrones of Blood! Command vampire legions, build your dark empire with blood magic, and dominate sunless lands. Features a new vampire ruler, tomes, wildlife, and a story realm exploring Elder Vampire origins.

name: Gruniożerca Trilogy
summary: Gruniożerca Trilogy is a collection of three unique puzzle games starring Grunio – a food-loving pig with a big heart (and an even bigger appetite)! Retro visuals, quirky mechanics, and absurd humor now on modern platforms!

name: Courtroom Chaos: Starring Snoop Dogg
summary:
Welcome to Courtroom Chaos! All rise for Judge Snoop Dogg!

Courtroom Chaos is what happens when your game night enters the courtroom. The cases may be fake, but the laughs are 100% real. You and your friends take turns improvising your testimony, inventing absurd characters, spinning wild stories, and defending the indefensible. And it’s all moderated by the dynamic, AI-powered Judge Snoop Dogg who holds court, challenges your team, and reacts contextually to your testimony, all before delivering his final verdict.

No gaming hardware. No scripts. Just your voice, your imagination, and whatever chaos you bring to the bench.

name: Battlefield REDSEC
summary: Now entering REDSEC, a free-to-play destination built on Battlefield’s iconic DNA. Drop into Fort Lyndon for a Battle Royale only Battlefield can deliver, featuring massive-scale destruction, fast-paced squad play, and the deadliest ring in BR. Survive and advance in Gauntlet: an all-new cutthroat, knockout-style elimination mode where squads race to complete missions. Then redraw the lines of battle with Portal.

name: Hello Kitty and Friends: Freeze Tag Party
summary: Game Overview: Hello Kitty and Friends: Freeze Tag Party is an action game where popular Sanrio characters play an exciting game of tag in a magical world!

name: Netbreak
summary: Welcome to Netbreak, a horror-puzzle experience. When a mysterious USB drive arrives on your desk, your curiosity drags you into a nightmare. Piece together clues, watch forbidden videos, and take down an underground SNUFF marketplace, that allows you to see interactive torture and murder.

name: Kellan Graves: Fallen
summary: A dark sci-fi FPS survival horror. Trapped underground after a fall, Kellan Graves faces the abyss – armed with nothing but a pistol and sheer will to survive.

name: Drifter Star: Evolution
summary: From a stardust speck to a galaxy-devouring titan. In this unique cosmic evolution game, experience the full life cycle from asteroid to galaxy. Each consumption brings growth; each evolution requires choice. The universe's ultimate secrets await your discovery.

name: Assassin’s Creed Mirage: Valley of Memory
summary:
A free major update introducing the new region of AlUla and featuring a new story arc for Basim. Players can explore the landscapes of deserts and oases as they uncover family secrets and face a ruthless gang threatening the valley’s peace.

The update also includes many gameplay improvements and changes for the whole game, including smoother parkour and mobility improvements, replayable missions and challenges, customizable experience with new difficulty levels, skills and tools customization and expanded features and fixes.

name: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora - From the Ashes
summary: Avatar Frontiers of Pandora: From the Ashes sees players embark on the journey of So’lek, a battle-hardened Na’vi warrior from the Trr’ong clan. Ambushed and left for dead by the RDA and their new allies—the ruthless Ash clan—So’lek awakens to a world in flames and his Sarentu family scattered.

name: TapMazing
summary: An addictive game where you guide Po-G, a quirky slime hero, through a vibrant and challenging environment. Inspired by scientific experiments, this game offers a unique blend of fun and strategy. Explore a lab full of surprises, where every tap unveils a new discovery!

name: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
summary:
Dodge and shoot to survive 15 seconds! Master 40 levels of arrow chaos in this fast-paced pixel art platformer!

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows. Each of the 40 unique levels introduces new challenges, from bouncing platforms that redirect your arrows to treacherous spikes and evolving mechanics that keep you on your toes.

Plan your shots carefully! The angle and direction of your arrows can make or break your survival, as they ricochet unpredictably or trigger new obstacles. Test your reflexes, sharpen your strategy and reach the final level. Can you survive the last 15 seconds of each level?

name: Star Wars: Beyond Victory
summary: Set during the Reign of Empire era, Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset introduces players to an original story that blends the thrilling world of podracing, a stellar cast, powerful narrative and mixed-reality play.

name: Synth Riders: Kendrick Lamar - "Humble." + Experience
summary: Step into Kendrick Lamar's world with the Synth Riders Experience for "HUMBLE." — an immersive musical journey inspired by the iconic music video.

name: Dobro Goranku
summary: A TCG like you’ve never played before. Dobro Goranku combines fast-paced action, deep strategy, and the art of bluffing, letting you build unique decks and defeat rivals in breathtaking duels.

name: Type
summary: a fast paced roguelike typing game with command abilities

name: A Spaceship Accident
summary: A choice-driven narrative game with RPG mechanics, filled with cosmic wonders and horror. Forge your own path across more than 50 unique endings. Barter, upgrade your character, fight, and explore alien worlds, overcoming every obstacle to find your way back to Earth… and to your daughter.

name: Next Run
summary: Fantasy strategy RPG with roguelike elements. A game about choice: every mechanic is an alternative to another. Fight or bribe, craft or trade, build or cast. Find your own path and reach victory.

name: Genshin Impact: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
summary:
Version "Luna II" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise". This update includes:
• New characters: Nefer and Miliastra Wonderland's Manekin
• New main story quest: "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight"
• New main event: Ruins Exploration - Fieldwise Center
• New QoL, and more!

Additionally, this update also adds Miliastra Wonderland, a new gameplay mode centered around user-generated content.

name: A Brat's Journey: A Rose Playing Game
summary: A narrative-driven RPG where you play as rosedoodle, a teal-haired catsprout, and embark on a journey across Stardust Valley. Visit various locations and interact with many of the Vchiban friends and family. Try and gather all the collectables, some which require gacha luck, fishing skill, and a sharp eye for details. Game lovingly made by rosedoodle's community for her 10th year anniversary.

name: Barrel Roll
summary: Barrel Roll is a roguelike deckbuilder, turn based, taking place in a futuristic far west. The deck ? A 6 slot revolver barrel. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminals as you can.

name: The House Remembers
summary: After your grandfather’s death, you return to his old house. But something's still there. Something that watches. Something that remembers. Face the haunting truth in this atmospheric psychological horror experience.

name: Mulan 2125
summary: In a future reshaped by the fall of a mysterious comet, humanity struggles between survival and domination. At the center of this fractured world stands Mulan, a young woman unknowingly carrying the hidden essence of Muk—a force that can both heal and destroy.

name: Shelf by Shelf
summary: Work in a warm, cozy bookstore, sort books by genre, and brighten your shelves! Shelf by Shelf invites you into a peaceful world with satisfying organizing mechanics. Help local readers find the perfect books, make them happy, grow your earnings, and expand your shop!

name: Fantasy Idle Dungeon
summary: In Fantasy Idle Dungeon, hatch and capture rare Jenin, awaken their legendary skills and talents, and experience the joy of leveling up, evolving, and fusing them. Freely customize your gear, assemble an unbeatable adventure team, and claim glorious victories with effortless idle gameplay!

name: Not Raised by Wolves
summary:
Not Raised by Wolves is a third-person shooter starring La Coyota, an anthropomorphic gunslinger. Dash, aim, and shoot with your revolver while your robotic sidekick hacks enemies to stun them and expose weak points in your fight to rescue the colony’s pups.

**A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience.

name: Monster Looter
summary: Kill monsters. Get loot. Get stronger. Then what? Kill BIGGER monsters. Get EVEN MORE loot. Upgrade. Upgrade again. Keep looting. Keep growing. How powerful will you be? Become the best monster looter in the world!

name: Vindilis
summary: Save the island of Vindilis and defeat the Omniscient! A short, epic adventure that will pit you against powerful enemies in a hand-drawn, hand-animated universe. A short-form indie game vengeance, creation, and completing a quest.

name: Letsss Play
summary: A blogger investigates disappearances at a mall built on the ashes of a circus. Posing as a night guard, he must uncover the truth behind the tragic fire and learn whose restless souls now haunt the halls. Gather clues and survive before the past consumes you.

name: Bread Adventure
summary: Experience a adventure in a seamless world of food, where you play as a brave bread. Freely explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, collect items to enhance your abilities, tackle challenging stages, and defeat formidable foes.

name: Incredicer
summary: Incredicer is an incremental dice game where you roll dice, earn money, upgrade and buy helper hands to automate and increase your income.

name: Nitroglycerine!
summary: A challenging arcade simulator of transporting dangerous cargo on heavy trucks along a complex and unpredictable route.

name: The House of Toys
summary: The House of Toys is a horror game in which the player ventures into an old mansion filled with seemingly harmless toys. His mission is to explore each room, searching for clues to discover which of the toys is cursed. To free the soul trapped in this toy, the player must solve intricate puzzles.

name: Aerthlings
summary: Use your NFC-enabled ÆRTHLINGS collectible toys to hatch, trade, and evolve digital creatures in the mobile game to rebuild ÆRTH.

name: Dogpile
summary: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!

name: BioMenace Remastered
summary: The classic 2D action platformer BioMenace returns with enhanced graphics and refined gameplay. Fight your way through a city ravaged by dangerous mutants, rescue hostages, find secrets and rack up points. Locate the secret lab behind this attack and prevent Dr. Mangle from taking over the world!

name: Witness to Plague
summary:
Are you interested in plague during the medieval times?
Then, this short-quiz game is for you.
Test your knowledge of history of medieval plague and then unlock a short movie called "Witness to Plague"

name: RV There Yet?
summary: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

name: The Beast Is yet to Come
summary: Unleash your inner beast in The Beast Is Yet To Come — a chaotic 3D action roguelike where you play as a brutal Troll crushing enemy hordes across multiple battlegrounds. Build devastating "punch hell" combos and fight through the storm.

name: Others
summary: This is a retro story game about choices and the voices in your head. Unlock new voices, new thoughts, and new endings.

name: Assetto Corsa Rally
summary: Assetto Corsa Rally is a high-fidelity rally sim built for precision and challenge. With 3D laser-scanned stages and cars, professional co-driver support, and dynamic conditions, it delivers a demanding, immersive experience where every second behind the wheel counts.

name: Shadow Mansion 2
summary: A terrifying secret buried in your family’s shadow awaits... Decaying walls, whisper-filled dark rooms — are you ready to confront the curse of the past? A short, gripping, and immersive horror experience is calling you.

name: Berrywitched! The Harvest
summary: Berrywitched! The Harvest is a direct sequel to the games Berrywitched! And Cherrywitched! It is recommended you play both of those games before playing this one for the best possible experience. In this game, you follow Strawberry as she finally gets the chance to leave her pocket dimension, and uncover the truth behind why she was sent there in the first place…

name: Kinetic Neo Ornate Bout
summary: Play two games at the same time—each with one stick of your controller. Score points, gain abilities, and don't forget to push the snails towards your opponent! They are the third and final dread in this extra hard multitasking challenge. K.N.O.B. will melt your brain! Play local with friends.

name: Ski Jumping World Cup
summary: Take flight in Ski Jumping World Cup - a true ski jumping adventure that takes you to legendary hills across the globe. From snowy peaks in Scandinavia to wind-swept arenas in Japan and record-breaking runs in the USA, every leap demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.

name: Panoptyca: Idle RPG Manager
summary: Discover a new style of RPG management gameplay. Experience the fun of an idle RPG that blends an innovative four-view battle system with a deep hero-growth mechanic.

name: The Myth of a Godslayer
summary: Follow Klain's mythical adventures in this top-down Action-RPG mixing combat, exploration, puzzles and platforming. Travel through the New World, explore forgotten dungeons, confront terrible foes and... become a Godslayer!

name: My Little Spider
summary: Adopt a cute pet spider that lives anywhere on your desktop! Team up to discover unique bugs, decorate their web, and unlock adorable spider hats as you work or relax.

name: Cryo
summary: CRYO is a multiplayer co-op survival horror. You have been deployed by your company to various locations around the Antarctic due to communication issues. What awaits you in these dark, remote regions is far more sinister than a technical fault.s

name: Fracturefront
summary: Fracturefront is a fantasy third-person 3D action roguelike. Centered on random equipment, it delivers a variable and strategically deep combat experience. Players take on the role of a warrior who travels through rifts to stop enemies from seizing the energy core.

name: Boat Together
summary: Hop on kayaks and boats for a fun adventure with up to 8 friends! Work together to paddle through cool waters, overcome obstacles and bosses, and reach new islands. If the legend is true, a hidden treasure awaits on the final island. Can you make it without sinking?

name: Goat Simulator 3: Baadlands: Furry Road
summary: Play as Baallistic Pilgor, the antihero and survivor of the apocalypse. Roam around the Baadlands on your motorcycle, butt heads with bizarre rival factions, establish your town and harass its citizens, and try to figure out what’s behind the mysterious vault.

name: Bluey's Quest for the Gold Pen
summary: Join Bluey on a fun-filled quest for the Gold Pen in an original story by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm. A joyful experience for the whole family.

name: Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition
summary: The base game, six official add-ons, and over 150 pieces of Creation Club content get bundled together in one neat package in celebration of Fallout 4’s 10th anniversary.

name: Fallout 76: Burning Springs
summary: A new region of the map is opening for those with enough grit to cross Point Pleasant bridge. It's time for you to travel westward towards Burning Springs. Taking place in rural Ohio, this is our largest map expansion to Fallout 76 yet!

name: Slumber Party
summary: A 4 player co-op horror game about a Slumber Party, where you and three friends are pulled into shared nightmares, each one a new level to survive. Work together to complete objectives and make it through the night.

name: Yakuza 20th Anniversary Edition
summary: The Yakuza 20th Anniversary Edition bundles three foundational entries in SEGA's crime drama series: Yakuza 0, a prequel set in 1980s Japan following the origin stories of Kiryu Kazuma and Majima Goro; Yakuza Kiwami, a modern remake of the original game where Kiryu investigates the theft of 10 billion yen in Tokyo's Kamurocho district; and Yakuza Kiwami 2, which continues Kiryu's saga as he mediates a brewing war between Tokyo and Osaka's criminal organizations. All three games feature beat-em-up combat, detailed city exploration, and various side activities within a narrative focused on honor, loyalty, and power in Japan's criminal underworld.

name: Street Racer Collection
summary: Street Racer is one of the most insane and fun kart racers of the 90s. Run, fight, and win! Speed and brawls on crazy tracks! A classic that mixes racing and fighting, bringing back chaotic battles and irreverent humor for up to 4 players!

name: Rush: Apex Edition
summary: RUSH: Apex Edition is a VR wingsuiting game where players dive from mountain peaks and race through canyons at high speed. Featuring remastered visuals, dynamic weather, and over 90 tracks, it offers both solo play and 12-player online races with global leaderboards and proximity chat. The game delivers an immersive, fast-paced flight experience enhanced by haptic feedback and high frame rates on PS5.

name: Vtuber Story
summary:
In this world, every village has a unique VTuber as its chief.
All the rules are created and managed by the village chief.
With the combined efforts of the chief and the player villagers,
what kind of village will it ultimately become?

Step into “VTuber Story” and join the streamers in building villages full of personality!

name: Frostpunk 2: Fractured Utopias
summary: The first Frostpunk 2 DLC expands Utopia Builder mode by adding structured Utopia Trees for each faction, powered by affinities. As factions’ trust grows you unlock faction-specific laws, buildings, and abilities that push their ideological goals. Completing a faction’s Utopia Tree enacts a single societal vision for the city and permanently resolves Tension, but pursuing utopia carries significant costs.

name: Don't Scream Together
summary: Don't Scream Together is an online co-op jumpscare horror simulator where you and friends walk through a pitch-black forest with camcorders in 1993. Use proximity chat and escape the forest. But if anyone screams or speaks too loudly, the game restarts or the screamer returns as the hunter!

name: Silly Survivors
summary: Silly Survivors - a casual, pared-down roguelike where you play as an adorable but fiercely determined furry fox, armed with… a flashlight! Your mission is simple: survive waves of suspiciously silly ghosts who keep trying to get close (and pull some kind of silly stuff). Light is your main weapon.

name: Cure: A Hospital Simulator
summary: Manage an ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: diagnose patients, design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. Integrate with Twitch chat for even more fun!

name: Leaf It Alone
summary: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

name: Sunday City
summary:
Sunday City is a city of eternal summer, luxury, and vivid impressions. Here, everyone can build a dazzling career, find new friends, and impress those around them with their individuality.

Every step is a step toward real success, which awaits you on the cozy streets of Sunday City.

name: Agyaat
summary: Agyaat is a first-person single-player horror game where you play as Acharya, drawn into the haunted depths of Ambika’s House to uncover a dark truth buried in Indian folklore. Explore, survive, and piece together the mansion’s twisted past — but beware, the house remembers every step you take.

name: Gorillas-Lab
summary: Gorillas-Lab is a VR sandbox game developed by Untitled Studios. There are many different things you can do such as making your own creations, exploring the lore, fight your friends in a C4 battle. You can do whatever you want in this game!

name: Z.A.T.O.: I Love the World and Everything In It
summary: USSR, 1986. A girl goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, yet not a soul seems to be concerned. Uncover the mystery behind her disappearance and transmit your signal to the universe.

name: Pyramidion
summary: Pyramidion is a physics-based co-op action-puzzler for 2 players. Choose a unique role and coordinate with your partner to move a massive stone block to the pyramid's summit in a true test of teamwork and communication.

name: Mega Man II SNES
summary: A mod that ports the Mega Man II to SNES console.

name: Mega Man SNES
summary: A mod that ports the Mega Man game to SNES.

name: Hotel Melancolie
summary:
A short, first-person psychological horror experience set inside a forgotten hotel where time, guilt, and memory all bleed together.

You wake up in Room 9.
The corridor outside loops back on itself.
Every time you step through the door, something has changed; the walls, the lights, the voice on the radio.

name: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return Special Edition
summary: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return Special Edition is an action-platformer following the pink-haired hero Tomba as he confronts the return of his porcine adversaries. This updated version of the 1999 PlayStation classic combines side-scrolling platforming with RPG elements, featuring quests and item collection across a colorful world where players must defeat evil pigs and restore peace to the land.

name: Dismayed
summary: Attempt to make sense of your twisted and macabre surroundings as the story unfolds. Will you figure out what's going on or will you succumb to the madness?

name: Two Point Museum: Zooseum
summary: Now hiring for Wildlife Experts to heal, raise and re-wild some wonderful wildlife in our brand new museum location!

name: Path of Exile 2: The Last of the Druids
Genshin Impact: A Nocturne of the Far North
summary:
Version "Luna III" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude". This update includes:
• New characters: Durin and Jahoda
• New main story quests: "A Nocturne of the Far North" and "Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist"
• New story quest for Durin
• New main event: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey
• New system: Witch's Homework
• New updates for Miliastra Wonderland
• New QoL, and more!

name: Chunithm X-Verse-X
summary: Chunithm's 10th anniversary celebration continues with the Chunithm New series coming to Linked Verse.

name: Spin Rhythm XD: Indie Pack DLC
summary: Take a road trip to a distant, heartfelt past with the Spin Rhythm XD Indie Pack. Spin through 7 nostalgic tunes from artists Hachiku, Blanco Tranco, Obscura Hail, and more.

name: My Winter Car
summary: My Winter Car is the ultimate challenge for project car owning, building, fixing, tuning and maintenance simulator. Sequel to My Summer Car, but with added challenge for those who can master the original game!

name: Robot Space Frenzy
summary: All the robots on Space Station 451 have gone berserk! Only one human is left alive! Can she survive the onslaught and escape? Blast your way through homicidal robots in this groovy throwback retro FPS!

name: Aaero2: Black Razor Edition
summary:
Black Razor Edition brings new music, bigger stages, and a sound shaped for late-night energy:
• Exclusive Black Razor Records tracks, including music from Arcade Paradise produced by former The Prodigy drummer Kieron Pepper
• Tracks from Lania Kea, a rising star in the Black Razor family.
• A lineup of Monstercat tracks
• Expanded environments and visuals inspired by Arcade Paradise, Black Razor Records, and more.

name: Cursflip
summary: Change your real Windows cursor, make it huge, collect hundreds of rare cursors, trade them on the Market and dominate clicker leaderboards!

name: Genesis
summary: A first-person survival horror set in an abandoned village. Scavenge notes, ammo, and supplies while being relentlessly hunted by a terrifying monster.

name: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.5 - To Be Fuel for the Night
summary:
Version 2.5 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Ye Shunguang and Zhao
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• New skins for Jane and Ye Shunguang
• ...and more!

name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - Thank You Update
summary: The "Thank You" update is a free major content update, including a brand-new level, “Verso’s Drafts”, featuring new environments to explore, battles to fight, and plenty of surprises to discover. The biome has a very childlike, wonderland-style aesthetic, inspired by Verso’s childhood, but you’ll see more cutscenes that elaborate on this in the update.

name: My Voice Zoo
summary: My Voice Zoo is a unique idle zoo game brought to life with your own voice. Record your sounds through the microphone and turn them into animal calls, creating a one-of-a-kind zoo found nowhere else. Start building your very own zoo, complete only with your voice!

name: Monkey Wave
summary: The Ape-pocalypse is here! Survive devastating waves, sharpen your reflexes, and defeat epic bosses in this fast-paced clicker full of PvP, co-op, and non-stop chaos.

name: Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition
summary: The psychological horror that shaped an entire genre returns - rebuilt from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5.

name: Marble Racing Manager
summary: Marble Racing Manager is an idle racing game where players collect and manage marbles that compete automatically. Players begin with free gems to purchase their first marble and expand their collection over time. Marbles are placed in a racing tray to enter competitions that occur automatically every 60 seconds, generating rewards without active player input. The game features an idle progression system where marbles continue racing and earning resources while the player is away.

name: Orchard Odyssey: Chestnut Christmas
summary: In Orchard Odyssey: Chestnut Christmas, you guide Aurora through a single vibrant orchard level to collect chestnuts in a Christmas-themed Orchard. You can run, jump, and unlock new abilities like double jump or enhanced map vision. The map is semi-procedural, being shuffled every time you enter the Orchard.

name: Psps Dream Mart
summary: Build, manage, and optimize your cozy supermarket where every customer is cute animal and every decision matters. From shelf placement to pricing strategy, your goal is simple: turn a humble mart into the ultimate feline shopping paradise

name: Isekai Villain
summary:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.

name: Forgotten Trails
summary:
Survive alone in a silent, abandoned world.

Humanity is gone. No cities, no voices — only endless forests, cold winds, and the distant howl of wolves.

How long can you last when the world no longer cares if you live or die?

Forgotten Trails is a hardcore survival experience focused on solitude, exploration, and true wilderness survival.

name: A Dark Cave
summary: A Dark Cave is a story-driven survival, settlement-building, and incremental adventure where every decision matters. Inspired by the minimalist incremental classics, A Dark Cave trades flashy graphics for intense atmosphere, discovery, and meaningful choices. Build a thriving village, uncover ancient secrets, and descend ever deeper into a world that becomes more dangerous the stronger you grow.
